name: btn-hover-outline
title: Outline Toggle Button
description: A pill-shaped Know More link with a double chevron. At rest it is white with black text; on hover it flips to black with a white outline, white text and white chevrons.
use: A clear secondary link is needed on a monochrome page and a hard colour inversion will read strongly.
avoid: The invert depends on a stark black-and-white pair, so it clashes with tinted or low-contrast themes.
a11y: It is a real link with visible text and a native focus ring, but the invert plays on hover only, never on focus. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white rounded pill holding bold black Know More text and a black double chevron. Hovered, it becomes a black pill with a thin white border and all of its content turns white.
behaves: Hovering flips the colours: the white fill darkens to black, a white border appears and the label and chevrons turn white. It is a quick colour change with no movement.
customise: The label, chevron icon and black-and-white palette are hardcoded; it accepts no props.
weight: light: One link with a colour transition and a single icon.
